body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> Torlys Smart Floors today announced the third straight year of double-digit sales increases for its Cork flooring collections at Surfaces 2009 in Las Vegas from Feb. 3-5.
(Photo: John Kocemba, Torlys VP Marketing at the Surfaces 2009 in Las Vegas)

"The extraordinary sales we've seen since our cork flooring introduction over the past few years doesn't surprise us," said John Kocemba, Torlys VP Marketing. "Cork just has too many good things going for it. We knew it wouldn't be long before consumers understood all the benefits."

Designers have long admired Torlys Cork as the "insider" choice. For good reason. Unique, eye-catching looks have always been an appealing cork feature, and lately its earth-friendly personality is getting attention, particularly in the United States and Canada.

Eco-innovation with cork is relatively easy since it comes from an entirely renewable resource. Cork bark is carefully harvested once every nine years in a time-honored tradition using hand tools - without destroying a single tree. Many century-old cork trees are still thriving and productive today in the beautiful forests of Portugal and Spain.

Torlys Cork uses a combination of harvested and recycled cork, and every floor is made with the patented 'Uniclic' joint, for easy installation without chemicals, glues or nails. Torlys Cork is backed with a high-density wood Smart Core and a layer of recycled cork, a naturally cushioned insulator that eliminates the need for an underlay.
